description:
Outcome warnings reach human output only, so `--json` consumers lose every warning a command reports. This puts a success outcome's warnings into its JSON response once, for every command.

## Background

12c0f3fb added `Outcome::with_warnings`. `emit_outcome` (`crates/jit/src/output/emit.rs`) prints them as `Warning: <w>` lines on stderr in human, non-quiet mode, and drops them under `--json`, where no human line may reach either stream. Before migration some arms printed warnings to stderr under `--json` too (`snapshot export`, 182f4c03), and others carry their own `warnings` field in the payload (`worktree list` and `store-divergence`, cd8e04cc). The success envelope is built by `JsonOutput::to_json_string` (`crates/jit/src/output.rs`), which injects `message` into the top-level object; `CommandSchema::generate` (`crates/jit/src/schema.rs`) derives each success schema.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Under `--json`, a success outcome's warnings appear in its response as one optional top-level `warnings` array of strings, emitted only when non-empty, beside `message`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The schema generator declares that optional `warnings` property once for every success schema, never per response type.
- [hard] REQ-03: Human mode is unchanged: warnings print as `Warning:` lines on stderr in non-quiet mode and nowhere under `-q`.
- [hard] REQ-04: Warnings attach to either outcome variant through one mechanism: a findings outcome carries them as a success does, human mode prints them as `Warning:` lines on stderr, and under `--json` a findings envelope carries them as a top-level `warnings` array beside `error`, as a success carries them beside `message`.
- [hard] REQ-05: Unit tests own the JSON emission for both variants (present when non-empty, absent when empty) and the schema declaration, and the generated schema of every real command differs only by the added optional property.

## Notes

REQ-04 added by steward ruling (2026-11-04): `gate preset apply` (1ac651c7) produces findings and lease warnings together, and `with_warnings` existed only on `Outcome::Success`.


Steward ruling (2026-11-04): fix the dropped warnings once in the emitter, not per command. 182f4c03 and cd8e04cc depend on this and drop their own fields. Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md` (D-42).
title: Success warnings appear in the JSON response
